methods.name: new
doc: Create an empty device manager.

methods.name: add
doc: Add a device to this manager.
Devices are attached in the order they are added. The device must
implement [`AttachDevice`] — all built-in device types
(`FsDevice`, `ConsoleDevice`, etc.) implement this trait.

methods.name: new
doc: Create a new virtiofs device sharing a host directory.
# Arguments
- `tag`: the filesystem tag visible to the guest (e.g. `"/dev/root"`).
- `host_path`: the host directory to share.

methods.name: new_read_only
doc: Create a read-only virtiofs device sharing a host directory.

methods.name: new_null
doc: Create a virtiofs device with no host directory (NullFs).
The guest sees an empty filesystem. Use [`FsOverlay`] to build
virtual entries and [`set_overlay`](Self::set_overlay) to attach
them.

methods.name: set_overlay
doc: Set a pre-built [`FsOverlay`] on this device.
The overlay entries are resolved (applied to the underlying
virtiofs device) during [`attach`](AttachDevice::attach).

methods.name: set_dax_window_size
doc: Set the size of the DAX (direct access) shared memory window.
When set, the guest can memory-map files from the shared filesystem
directly into its address space, avoiding data copies. If not set,
no DAX window is allocated.

methods.name: builder
doc: Create a new console builder.

methods.name: add_tty_port
doc: Add a TTY-backed port to the console.
If the fd refers to a real terminal, raw mode will be enabled on it
when the VM starts, and restored on shutdown.
# Arguments
- `name`: the port name visible to the guest (e.g. `"tty0"`).
- `tty_fd`: borrowed fd for the host TTY; duplicated internally, caller retains ownership.
# Returns
The zero-based port index.

methods.name: add_inout_port
doc: Add a port with separate input and output fds (no terminal properties).
Pass `None` to disable that direction.

methods.name: build
doc: Build the console device. At least one port must have been added.

methods.name: add_default_console
doc: Set up the default console: port 0 (hvc0) plus named redirect ports.
Replicates the v1 `krun_add_virtio_console_default` behaviour:
- If any fd is a terminal, port 0 becomes a full TTY console
(raw mode enabled), and that fd is NOT added as a redirect port.
- Otherwise, port 0 gets log output and named redirect ports
(`krun-stdin`, `krun-stdout`, `krun-stderr`) are added.
Pass `None` to skip a stream.

methods.name: new
doc: Create a new empty overlay.

methods.name: add_dir
doc: Add a virtual directory entry.
`path` may contain `/` separators for nested entries (e.g. `"etc/nested"`).
Intermediate directories must already exist in the overlay.

methods.name: add_file
doc: Add a virtual file entry.
`path` may contain `/` separators for nested entries (e.g. `"etc/nested/file.txt"`).
Intermediate directories must already exist in the overlay.

methods.name: add_serial_console
doc: Add a legacy serial console device with the given input and output file descriptors.
Can be called multiple times to add multiple serial consoles (ttyS0, ttyS1, …).
This is required for FreeBSD guests which use the legacy serial console instead
of the virtio console.

methods.name: handle
doc: Obtain a thread-safe handle to the inner VMM.
Must be called before [`run`](Self::run) which consumes `self`.
The handle can be moved to another thread for pause/resume.

methods.name: shutdown
doc: Signal the guest to perform an orderly ACPI shutdown.
On macOS this writes to the GPIO device's eventfd, which triggers
a restart-key press in the guest. On other platforms this is not
supported.

methods.name: new
doc: Create a new vsock device.
`tsi_features` is a bitmask of TSI flags (0 to disable).

methods.name: add_port_forward
doc: Add a host port forwarding: `"guest_port:host_port"`.

methods.name: add_unix_port
doc: Add a Unix socket port mapping.

methods.name: new
doc: Create a new block device.
Defaults to read-write (`read_only = false`), cached I/O (`direct_io = false`),
and [`SyncMode::Relaxed`].

methods.name: set_read_only
doc: Set whether the block device is read-only.

methods.name: set_direct_io
doc: Set whether to bypass the host caches.

methods.name: set_sync_mode
doc: Set whether to enable VIRTIO_BLK_F_FLUSH.
On macOS, an additional relaxed sync mode is available, which is enabled by default,
and will not ask the drive to flush its buffered data.

methods.name: new_unixgram_path
doc: Create a net device backed by a Unix datagram socket path.

methods.name: new_unixgram_fd
doc: Create a net device backed by a Unix datagram socket fd.
Takes ownership of `fd`; the caller must not close it after this call.

methods.name: new_unixstream_path
doc: Create a net device backed by a Unix stream socket path.

methods.name: new_unixstream_fd
doc: Create a net device backed by a Unix stream socket fd.
Takes ownership of `fd`; the caller must not close it after this call.

methods.name: new
doc: Create a new vhost-user device.
# Arguments
- `device_type`: virtio device type ID (e.g. 4 for RNG, 32 for Sound).
- `socket_path`: path to the vhost-user Unix domain socket.
- `name`: human-readable name for logging. If empty, defaults to
`"vhost-user-{device_type}"`.
- `num_queues`: number of queues (0 = query backend via MQ protocol).
- `queue_sizes`: size for each queue (empty slice = use default of 256).

methods.name: new
doc: Create from the opaque pre-ffier `krun_display_backend` vtable pointer.
# Safety
`vtable` must point to a valid `krun_display_backend` struct of at least
`vtable_size` bytes. The struct is copied — the caller retains ownership
of the original.

methods.name: new
doc: Create from opaque config/events backend vtables.
# Safety
`config_backend` must point to a valid `InputConfigBackend` struct of at
least `config_backend_size` bytes, and `event_provider_backend` must
point to a valid `InputEventProviderBackend` struct of at least
`event_provider_backend_size` bytes. Both structs are copied — the
caller retains ownership of the originals.

methods.name: new_from_fd
doc: Create a passthrough input device from an evdev fd.
The fd must refer to a Linux `/dev/input/eventN` device. It is
duplicated internally; the caller retains ownership.
